10.64898/2026.09.24.750079.title: Stimulatrix: An open-source automated platform for high-throughput functional characterization of engineered contractile tissues
10.64898/2026.09.24.750079.news_text: We have shared Stimulatrix, an open-source automated platform for high-throughput functional characterization of engineered contractile tissues. The work is available as a bioRxiv preprint.

10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.01.014.news_title: New article on epicardial patches for myocardial repair
10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.01.014.news_text: Our article in Trends in Biotechnology examines approaches to overcome the epicardial barrier, together with material, safety and clinical considerations for myocardial repair.

10.1002/advs.202512727.news_text: Our study in Advanced Science presents gravity-independent filamented light biofabrication of muscle constructs and bioresins that support prolonged cell encapsulation before printing.

10.1002/adhm.202405105.news_title: Photoclickable collagen bioresins for rapid printing
10.1002/adhm.202405105.news_text: Our study in Advanced Healthcare Materials introduces photoclickable collagen-based bioresins for rapid deep vat printing of complex tissue constructs.
